notes: Layer-(a) assertions on the emitted pipeline plan (PlanArtifact shape). Live pipeline run to phase 9 on the eval fixture site (agents/flowsmith/eval/fixture.json) is layer b.

cases.input: Produce the phase plan (PlanArtifact) for a new 12-page B2B Webflow site. Design input: reference set. Client will send feedback via Pastel. Includes a blog CMS and imagery to be generated (estimated $60 of gen-media credits). Migration from an old WordPress site.

expects.assertion: The copy phase (brand-profile, page-copy, humanise, approval) is sequenced BEFORE section builds, with the rationale that whtml bakes text in.
IA/sitemap gets operator approval before design direction begins.
Because the design input is references, the plan includes the design-interpretation approval gate (3b).
The plan crawls the old WordPress site to build the URL inventory BEFORE producing the redirect map.
Production publish is a Tier 3 gate whose exit condition is the launch-day production SEO re-run on the custom domain.
Pages stay draft:true during construction and flip only entering their own verify loop.
Revision handling classifies items and flags scope changes rather than absorbing them; rounds are capped at 2.

Section builders never publish individually; the plan batches one staging publish per wave, taken under the publish lock with publishToWebflowSubdomain true and customDomains [], respecting the ~1/min publish_site rate limit.
Before any compress_assets step, the plan records each asset's original hostedUrl and downloads the original file, because compression replaces the hosted file with no undo.
